label: local simulation, not the customer Office
note: Local simulation, NOT the customer Office: the real deployment bundle was built and extracted, run in SAFI_MODE=office with a separate data folder, stopped and started again. The agent and its private profile survived, the manifest is byte-identical, training routes answered 403 OFFICE_MODE, and the bundle contains no data folder and no .env file.

error.message: Training is done in the SAFI Factory, not in the Office.
error.hint: Ask the SAFI Trainer to make and publish changes in the Factory, then deploy them to the Office.
